Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 14), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the two bands were formed in the same city. The evidence gathered in the previous step clearly showed the Goo Goo Dolls were formed in Buffalo, New York, and Echosmith was formed in Chino, California. These are two distinct cities. The Planner failed to perform the basic logical comparison between "Buffalo, New York" and "Chino, California" and erroneously stated "They are formed in the same city. Yes."
